About the shop

Pomel is a retail experience created for fans of all things Japanese lifestyle and culture. We carry exclusive and unique apparel, accessories, and more. At first, Pomel was a way for us to express our love and art in the form of Anime styles.

After discovering that our friends love the designs, we created our own shop to create one spot for all anime fans to find cool anime goods, and take this project to the next level to share this Sugoi experience with all Anime and Manga lovers.
